DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日の担当は、朝礼の後に班長が案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-01.translation: Pagkatapos ng morning meeting, team leader ang magsasabi ng gawain ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 掲示に北側広場とあったので、工具を持ってそこで作業を始めようと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 避難掲示の場所で作業を始めようとしたことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-02.translation: May nakasulat pong north plaza sa paskil kaya balak kong dalhin ang tools at magsimula roon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing balak magsimula sa lugar ng evacuation notice. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 北側広場は、この掲示では避難時の集合場所です。今日の作業場所の指定ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sa paskil na ito, north plaza ang evacuation meeting point. Hindi ito takdang trabaho ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見出しを読まず場所だけ見ていました。まだ工具は運んでいません。今日の担当は班長に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未搬入を報告し見出しの取り違いを修正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-04.translation: Lugar lang po ang nakita ko at hindi binasa ang heading. Hindi ko pa nadadala ang tools. Sa leader ko titiyakin ang gawain.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Iulat na hindi pa nadadala ang gamit at itama ang maling heading. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。避難場所も覚えておいてください。作業先とは別に案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-05.translation: Oo. Tandaan din ang evacuation point. Hiwalay ito sa lugar ng trabaho.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 避難場所へ行く経路も、資材運搬の経路と同じだと決めず確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 避難経路と資材運搬経路を別に確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-06.translation: Gusto ko ring tiyakin ang evacuation route nang hindi ipinapalagay na pareho ng rutang pangmateryales.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hilinging hiwalay na tiyakin ang evacuation at material transport routes. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 当日の通行状況を含めて担当が説明します。説明後は班に合流してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ipapaliwanag ng namamahala pati ang daanang bukas ngayon. Sumama sa team matapos ang paliwanag.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 班名が似ていて間違えそうです。自分が入る班の名前と班長を教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 所属班名と班長の特定を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-08.translation: Magkahawig po ang team names kaya baka magkamali. Pakisabi ang team ko at sino ang leader.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hilinging tukuyin ang sariling team at leader. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この班です。班長を呼びますので、工具は決められた置場に残しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-09.translation: Itong team. Tatawagin ang leader; iwan muna ang tools sa itinakdang puwesto.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。班長から作業場所と役割を聞き、避難経路の説明も受けてから工具を運びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当と避難経路の説明後に工具を運ぶと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sige po. Pakikinggan ko ang lugar at tungkulin sa leader pati evacuation route bago dalhin ang tools.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing dadalhin ang gamit matapos ang paliwanag ng tungkulin at evacuation route. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順で確認しましょう。掲示だけを見て作業は始めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-014-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ganiyan ang pagkakasunod. Huwag magsimula batay lamang sa paskil.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 症状は昨日からと記入されていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-01.translation: Nakasulat pong kahapon nagsimula ang sintomas.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日は初めて相談した日です。実際には先週から、時々同じ症状がありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記入した昨日は初回相談日だと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-02.translation: Kahapon po ang unang konsultasyon. Sa totoo lang, paminsan-minsan na ito mula noong nakaraang linggo.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itama na ang isinulat na kahapon ay unang konsultasyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 始まった日と、相談した日は違うのですね。先週の何曜日か覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-03.translation: Magkaiba pala ang simula at konsultasyon. Anong araw noong nakaraang linggo, naaalala?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 曜日は確かではありません。最初に気付いたのは休日の朝で、勤務を休んだ日とは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発症曜日は不確かで休日の朝に気付いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi po tiyak ang araw. Una kong napansin noong umaga ng day off, hindi araw na lumiban ako sa trabaho.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na hindi tiyak ang araw at napansin sa umaga ng pahinga. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確かでない日は断定せず、その範囲で記録しましょう。毎日続いていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-05.translation: Huwag tiyaking araw ang hindi sigurado; itala sa saklaw na iyan. Araw-araw bang tuloy-tuloy?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 毎日ではありません。間に症状のない日もあるので、先週からずっと続いたとは書かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 連日継続でなく症状のない日もあったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi po araw-araw. May pagitan na walang sintomas kaya huwag isulat na tuloy-tuloy mula noong nakaraang linggo.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi araw-araw at may walang sintomas na araw. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 症状のあった日が分かるメモはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-07.translation: May tala po ba ng mga araw na nagkaroon?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二日分だけ携帯に残っています。その二日が全部だとは言えませんが、診察で見せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二日分の記録は経過全体ではないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-08.translation: Dalawang araw lang po sa telepono. Hindi ko masabing iyon lahat, pero gusto kong ipakita sa pagsusuri.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi buong kasaysayan ang dalawang araw na tala. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記録のある日と、記憶だけの日を分けて担当者へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ipapasa sa namamahala nang hiwalay ang may tala at naaalala lamang.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。昨日の相談日を発症日として扱わず、時々あったこととメモの範囲を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発症と相談と記録範囲を分けて引継ぎを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap po. Huwag ituring na simula ang konsultasyon kahapon; ipapaliwanag ko ang paminsan-minsan at saklaw ng memo.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hilinging hiwalay na ipasa ang simula, konsultasyon at saklaw ng tala. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容を記録します。メモは診察で担当者にお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-015-001-SHARED-11.translation: Itatala iyan. Ipakita ang memo sa tagasuri.

DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入場券を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-01.translation: Maaari pong makita ang admission ticket?

DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この番号付きの券です。グッズを買う時に受け取りました。これで入れますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 物販整理券で入れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-02.translation: Itong may numero po. Nakuha ko sa pagbili ng merchandise. Makakapasok ba rito?
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung makakapasok gamit ang merchandise queue ticket. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それは物販の整理券です。試合の入場券は別にお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-03.translation: Queue ticket po iyon ng merchandise. May hiwalay bang admission ticket sa laro?

DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 購入メールがあります。物販の番号を座席番号と思っていたので、メールから入場券を開きます。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 整理番号と座席を区別し入場券を開く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-04.translation: May purchase email po. Akala ko seat number ang merchandise number kaya bubuksan ko ang admission ticket sa email.
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang queue number at seat at buksan ang admission ticket. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 画面の日付と対戦するチームを確認してください。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tiyakin ang petsa at magkalabang teams sa screen.

DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日の日付ですが、友人の分も同じメールにあります。二枚を順番に出せば二人入れますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二人分の券が同じメールにあると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-06.translation: Petsa po ngayon, pero kasama sa email ang sa kaibigan ko. Kapag sunod na ipinakita ang dalawa, makakapasok ba kaming dalawa?
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na nasa iisang email ang dalawang tiket. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この券の扱いと同行者の入場方法を係員が確認します。友人はご一緒ですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-07.translation: Titiyakin ng kawani ang paghawak sa tiket at pagpasok ng kasama. Kasama na po ang kaibigan?

DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ駅です。自分の分だけ確認してもらい、友人の券を今ここで使用したことにはしないでください。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不在の友人分を使用せず自分だけ確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-08.translation: Nasa estasyon pa po. Akin lang ang pakitingnan at huwag ituring na nagamit na rito ang kanya.
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hilinging sariling tiket lang ang tingnan at hindi gamitin ang sa wala pang kaibigan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人分を区別して確認します。友人の入場方法は、その券の案内を読んでお伝えください。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ihihiwalay ang sa inyo. Basahin ang gabay ng tiket at ipaalam ang paraan ng pagpasok sa kaibigan.

DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。自分の入場券を提示し、友人には物販整理券では入れないことと本人の券の案内を伝えます。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の券を提示し友人へ券の違いと利用案内を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Ipapakita ko ang akin at sasabihin sa kanya na hindi makakapasok sa merchandise ticket at ibibigay ang gabay ng sariling tiket niya.
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang sariling tiket at ipaalam sa kaibigan ang pagkakaiba at gabay. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、ご本人分の券を確認します。整理券は別に保管してください。
DLG-SC-TKY-BUNKYO-001-SHARED-11.translation: Titingnan ang sa inyo. Itabi nang hiwalay ang queue ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 返却についてのご相談ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家には二冊しかありませんが、この一覧には三冊あります。一冊なくしたと思って探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 履歴三冊と手元二冊の不一致を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Dalawang libro lang po sa bahay pero tatlo sa listahan. Hinahanap ko ang isa dahil akala ko nawala.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Magtanong tungkol sa tatlo sa history at dalawa sa kamay. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの一覧を見ているか確認しましょう。これは貸出履歴の画面です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tiyakin ang listahang nakikita. Borrowing history po ang screen na ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 現在借りている本だけの一覧だと思っていました。貸出中の画面はどこで見られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 履歴と貸出中を区別し現在の画面を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Akala ko po kasalukuyang hiram lang. Saan makikita ang kasalukuyang loans?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang history at kasalukuyang hiram at itanong ang screen. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらです。この画面の二冊と、お持ちの本を照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Dito. Itugma ang dalawang nasa screen sa dala ninyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二冊とも一致しています。履歴のもう一冊には返却日がありますね。未返却とは申し出ないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現貸出二冊を照合し返却済みを紛失扱いしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Tugma po pareho. May return date ang isa pang nasa history. Hindi ko iuulat na hindi pa naibalik.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itugma ang dalawang kasalukuyang hiram at huwag ituring na nawawala ang naibalik. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記録の意味が分からなければ、窓口で確認できます。今日は二冊とも返しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Kung hindi malinaw ang record, magtanong sa counter. Pareho po bang ibabalik ngayon?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一冊はまだ読みたいです。二冊の状態が分かったので、返すのはこの一冊だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返す一冊と継続して読む一冊を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Gusto ko pa pong basahin ang isa. Alam na ang status ng dalawa, kaya ito lang ang ibabalik.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang ibabalik at patuloy na babasahing libro. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、その一冊の返却処理をします。残す本の期限は現在の貸出画面で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ipoproseso ang isang iyon. Tingnan sa current loans ang deadline ng natira.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。処理後に一覧を見直し、残る一冊と期限を確認します。履歴は現在の貸出数には数えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返却処理後に残る一冊と期限を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Titingnan ko muli matapos iproseso ang natitirang isa at deadline. Hindi ko ibibilang ang history sa kasalukuyang dami.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang natitirang isa at deadline matapos ang return processing. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 一冊をお預かりします。処理が終わるまでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Kukunin ang isang libro. Maghintay hanggang tapos.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日の会計はこちらで済みました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tapos na po ang bayad ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この紙を会社へ出せば、健診結果を提出したことになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 領収書が健診結果の提出になるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Kapag ipinasa ko po itong papel sa kompanya, naipasa ko na ba ang checkup result?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung katumbas ng checkup result submission ang resibo. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: これは費用の領収書です。結果の書類は、別に案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Resibo po ito ng gastos. Hiwalay na ituturo ang result document.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会計の紙を結果だと思っていました。会社が求めるのは結果なので、受け取り方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 領収書と結果を区別し結果受取方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Akala ko po resulta ang papel sa bayad. Resulta ang kailangan ng kompanya kaya pakituro ang pagkuha.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang resibo at resulta at itanong ang pagkuha ng resulta. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 結果の発行について担当が説明します。会社の提出案内はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ipapaliwanag ng namamahala ang issuance. Dala ang submission guide ng kompanya?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。提出先の指定書式があります。領収書をそこへ貼って代用せず、担当に見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社の指定書式を示し領収書で代用しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Opo. May itinakdang form. Hindi ko ididikit ang resibo bilang kapalit; ipapakita sa namamahala.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang form ng kompanya at huwag gamitin ang resibo bilang kapalit. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が書式と発行方法を確認します。発行時期も聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Titiyakin ang form at issuance. Itanong din ang petsa ng paglabas.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社の期限に間に合うかを自分で決めつけず、案内された発行時期を会社へ伝えて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発行時期を確認して会社の期限を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi ko po basta iisiping aabot sa deadline; sasabihin sa kompanya ang naipaliwanag na issuance at kukonsulta.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang issuance at pag-usapan ang deadline sa kompanya. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 支払いに関する手続きと、結果書類の手続きは別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Hiwalay ang bayad at proseso ng resulta.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 領収書は自分の支払記録として保管します。結果の書式と時期を担当に確認してから提出を準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 支払記録を保管し結果の書式と時期を別に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Itatabi ko po ang resibo bilang tala ng bayad. Ihahanda ang submission matapos tiyakin ang form at oras sa namamahala.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Itabi ang payment record at hiwalay na tiyakin ang form at oras ng resulta. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、結果書類の担当へご案内します。会社の書式もお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Igagabay sa results officer. Dalhin din ang company form.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お帰りの手続きですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: もう一度お風呂へ入りたいです。館内着を返却箱へ入れましたが、精算はまだです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 再入浴希望と館内着返却済み精算前を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Gusto ko pong maligo muli. Naibalik ko na sa box ang lounge clothes pero hindi pa nagbayad.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing nais muling maligo, naibalik na ang damit ngunit hindi pa nagbayad. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 館内着を返した状態と、退館の手続きは分けて確認します。利用証はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ihihiwalay ang pagbabalik ng damit at exit procedure. May use pass po kayo?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 持っています。服を返しただけで利用時間が終わったと思っていましたが、扱いを確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 利用証を示し返却と利用終了の関係を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Mayroon po. Akala ko tapos na ang paggamit dahil naibalik ang damit; maaari bang tiyakin ang patakaran?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang pass at tiyakin ang ugnayan ng pagbabalik at pagtatapos ng paggamit. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が今の利用状態と再入浴の条件を確認します。ご自身の服には着替えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titiyakin ng namamahala ang current status at muling pagligo. Nakapagpalit na sa sariling damit?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。替えの館内着が当然もらえるとは考えず、必要な手順を聞いてから戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 着替え済みを報告し追加貸出しの手順を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Opo. Hindi ko ipapalagay na awtomatikong may bagong lounge clothes; pakikinggan muna ang kailangan bago bumalik.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Iulat na nakapagpalit at itanong ang bagong pagpapahiram. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内前には浴室へ戻らず、こちらでお待ちください。追加の貸出しや料金も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Dito maghintay, huwag bumalik sa paliguan bago ang gabay. Titiyakin ang dagdag na damit at bayad.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。返却箱の服を取り戻すこともしません。利用証を出してここで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返却服を取り出さず案内を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sige po. Hindi ko rin kukunin ang naibalik sa box. Ipapakita ko ang pass at maghihintay rito.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag kunin ang naibalik na damit at hintayin ang gabay. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から再入浴と精算の説明をします。条件によっては、そのまま退館する選択もできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ipapaliwanag ang muling pagligo at bayad. Maaari ring piliing lumabas ayon sa kondisyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明を聞いてから決めます。追加費用があるなら金額も確認し、戻るか退館するか伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加費用も含め説明後に再入浴か退館か決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pagpapasyahan ko po matapos marinig. Kung may dagdag, titiyakin ang halaga at sasabihin kung babalik o lalabas.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpasya sa pagligo o paglabas matapos ang paliwanag kasama ang dagdag na presyo. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。現時点では退館処理を進めず、確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige po. Hindi muna ipoproseso ang exit habang sinusuri.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような見学をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Anong pagbisita po ang gusto ninyo?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 大学の案内に一般公開とあります。学生の授業を途中から見学したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一般公開を通常授業の自由見学と思った希望を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: May open to public sa university guide. Gusto kong manood sa kalagitnaan ng regular class ng estudyante.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang hiling na inakalang malayang regular class visit ang open to public. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 何が一般公開されるかは、案内の内容を確認する必要があります。掲載された企画名は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Kailangang basahin kung ano ang bukas sa publiko. Alam po ang pangalan ng programa?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 公開講座と書いてあります。普段の授業を自由に見られる意味ではなかったのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 公開講座と通常授業を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Public lecture po ang nakasulat. Hindi pala ibig sabihing malayang manood sa ordinaryong klase.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang public lecture at regular class. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 公開講座への参加条件は、主催者の案内で確認してください。敷地の見学条件とも別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tiyakin sa organizer ang participation conditions. Hiwalay rin sa campus visit rules.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 講座は時間が合いません。建物の外観を見る希望へ変えたいので、入れる範囲を主催者に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 講座に参加せず外観見学の範囲を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi po tugma ang oras ng lecture. Gusto kong palitan sa panlabas na gusali, kaya tatanungin ang organizer ang mapapasok na lugar.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi sasali sa lecture at nais tiyakin ang saklaw ng exterior visit. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 公開講座の申込みをしても、ほかの建物へ入れるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Kahit mag-apply sa lecture, hindi tiyak na makapapasok sa ibang gusali.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 見学のためだけに講座へ申し込むことはしません。外観を見る範囲が分かってから、周辺散策と組み合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見学目的だけの講座申込をせず散策計画を調整する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi po ako mag-aapply para lang makatingin. Kapag alam ang exterior scope, isasama ko sa paglalakad sa paligid.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag mag-apply sa lecture para lang sa pagbisita at ayusin ang walking plan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 目的地は、講座会場ではなく見学可能な入口に合わせて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Itugma ang destinasyon sa maaaring pasukang entrance, hindi sa lecture venue.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。主催者から見学範囲を聞き、入れる入口を確認してから行程を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 許可範囲と入口を確認して行程を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Itatanong ang visit scope at entrance sa organizer bago magtakda ng itinerary.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang pahintulot at entrance bago magtakda ng itinerary. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 連絡先の載った案内をお渡しします。講座と見学の条件を分けてお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ibibigay ang gabay na may contact. Magkahiwalay na itanong ang lecture at pagbisita.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ラインの状態を教えてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 画面に停止と出ています。部品が途中に残っているので、手で取れば再開できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 停止表示を見て内部の部品を取れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Stopped po sa screen. May piyesang naiwan sa gitna; puwede bang kunin sa kamay para magpatuloy?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung makukuha ang piyesa sa loob batay sa stopped display. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 停止表示だけで、内部へ手を入れてよいとは判断しないでください。担当が状態と手順を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Huwag isipin mula sa stopped display lang na puwedeng ipasok ang kamay. Titiyakin ng namamahala ang status at hakbang.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ手は入れていません。停止表示が出たことと、部品が残って見えることを報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未接触と観察事実を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi ko pa po ipinasok. Iuulat ko ang stopped display at nakikitang naiwan na piyesa.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Iulat na hindi nahawakan at ang naobserbahan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 操作盤にも触らず、担当を待ってください。いつからその状態ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Huwag ding galawin ang panel; hintayin ang namamahala. Kailan nagsimula?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 材料を入れた後からです。原因は分からないので、部品が詰まったと断定せず経過を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発生時点を伝え原因を推測で断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pagkatapos po ipasok ang materyal. Hindi ko alam ang sanhi kaya pangyayari ang sasabihin, hindi ko tiyak na bara.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang simula at huwag tiyaking sanhi ang hula. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 周囲の人にも、確認前に操作しないよう知らせてください。復旧作業は指定担当が行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sabihin din sa paligid na huwag patakbuhin bago masuri. Itinakdang tao ang magpapanumbalik.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 隣の作業員に知らせます。自分の判断で停止を解除せず、指定担当に現状を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 周囲へ操作停止を知らせ指定担当に引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sasabihin ko po sa katabi. Hindi ko sariling aalisin ang stop at ipapaliwanag ang kalagayan sa itinalaga.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipaalam sa paligid na huwag patakbuhin at ipasa sa itinalagang tao. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 私が引き継ぎます。離れる必要がある時も、担当への引継ぎを済ませてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ako ang tatanggap. Kung kailangang umalis, tiyaking naipasa sa namamahala.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。表示と発生時点を引き継ぎ、再開の指示が出るまでは材料の投入も止めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示と時点を引き継ぎ再開指示まで投入を止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sige po. Ipapasa ang display at simula at ihihinto rin ang pagpasok ng materyal hanggang may restart instruction.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipasa ang display at oras ng simula at ihinto ang materyal hanggang may tagubilin. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのままお待ちください。確認が終わってから次の作業を指示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Maghintay. Sasabihin ang susunod matapos masuri.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この区画の給餌は、個体の割当表を確認して進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Sa pagpapakain dito, tiyakin ang individual allocation chart.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 表には五頭ですが、見えるのは四頭です。五頭分を四頭へ分ければよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記録五頭と目視四頭の違いと配分案を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Lima po sa chart pero apat ang nakikita. Hahatiin ba ang para sa lima sa apat?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Magtanong tungkol sa limang nasa tala, apat na nakikita at mungkahing hatian. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 頭数の違いを確認する前に、配分を変えないでください。今は給餌を始めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Huwag baguhin bago matiyak ang bilang. Nagsimula na bang magpakain?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。一頭が見えないという観察で、移動したかどうかまでは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未給餌で不在理由は不明だと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi pa po. Isa ang hindi nakikita pero hindi ko alam kung lumipat.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Iulat na hindi pa pinakain at hindi alam ang dahilan ng pagkawala sa paningin. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 柵の外から確認できる個体識別と区画名を報告してください。中へ探しに入らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Iulat ang animal IDs na matitiyak mula sa labas ng bakod at area name. Huwag pumasok para maghanap.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見える四頭の番号と区画名を控えます。離れたところの一頭を、ここの五頭目だと数えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 柵外で番号を確認し別区画の個体と混同しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Itatala ko po ang apat na numero at lugar. Hindi ko ibibilang na panlima rito ang isang malayo.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang numero mula sa labas at huwag ihalo ang hayop ng ibang lugar. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 私が当日の移動記録と照合します。飼料はほかの区画へ回さず、そのまま置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Itutugma ko sa movement record ngayon. Huwag ipamigay ang feed sa ibang lugar; iwan muna.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この区画用の飼料を分けた状態で残します。不足と思って追加することもせず、結果を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 飼料を区画別に保ち追加配分をせず待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pananatilihin ko pong hiwalay ang para rito. Hindi ko dadagdagan sa pag-aakalang kulang; maghihintay ng resulta.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Panatilihin ang feed ayon sa area at maghintay nang walang dagdag na alokasyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 照合が終わってから対象と配分を指示します。ほかの人に引き継ぐ時も確認前だと伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Pagkatapos ng pagtutugma, ituturo ang target at hatian. Ipaalam ding hindi pa tiyak kapag ipinasa sa iba.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。四頭が見えた時点と番号を報告し、この区画は確認待ちで未給餌だと共有します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 観察時点と番号を報告し確認待ち未給餌を共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sige po. Iuulat ang oras na apat ang nakita at mga numero, at ibabahaging naghihintay ng pagtiyak at hindi pa pinakain dito.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Iulat ang oras at mga numero at ibahaging naghihintay at hindi pa pinakain. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その情報で確認します。指示が出るまでは配分を変えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Gagamitin iyan sa pagtiyak. Huwag baguhin ang hatian hangga't walang tagubilin.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 宛先の記入に抜けがないか、ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tiyaking walang kulang sa destinasyong address.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人も私と同じ建物なので、住所は一か所だけ書きました。部屋番号だけ追加すれば足りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ建物の友人への宛先記入を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Pareho po kaming gusali ng kaibigan kaya isang address lang ang isinulat. Sapat bang idagdag ang room number?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Magtanong tungkol sa address ng kaibigang nasa parehong gusali. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宛先と差出人は別の欄です。同じ建物でも、どちらの住所か分かるように記入してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Magkaibang field ang sender at recipient. Kahit parehong gusali, malinaw na isulat kung kaninong address.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今の欄は自分の差出人住所でした。そこへ友人の部屋番号を足さず、宛先欄へ友人の住所を書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 差出人欄を修正せず別の宛先欄に記入すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sender address ko po pala ang naisulat. Hindi ko idaragdag doon ang room niya; sa recipient ko isusulat ang address niya.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi babaguhin ang sender field at sa hiwalay na recipient field magsusulat. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。ご自身の部屋番号も、ご自身の欄で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Opo. Tiyakin rin sa sariling field ang room number ninyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分は二〇一、友人は三〇一です。似ているので、両方をそれぞれの名前と合わせて読み直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自他の部屋番号と名前を組にして読み直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: 201 po ako at 301 siya. Magkahawig kaya babasahin ko uli nang kasama ang bawat pangalan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Basahin muli ang bawat room number kasama ng pangalan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 友人のお名前の表記も、本人に確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Natiyak na rin po sa kanya ang spelling ng pangalan?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ略称しか知りません。受取人の正式な表記を確認してから記入を終えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受取人名が未確認だと申告し本人に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Nickname lang po ang alam. Tatapusin ko matapos matiyak ang pormal na pangalan ng tatanggap.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi pa tiyak ang recipient name at tatanungin mismo siya. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その確認ができてから、お持ちください。今は発送処理には進めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Dalhin matapos matiyak. Hindi muna magpapatuloy sa shipping ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。ラベルを持ち帰り、二つの住所欄と受取人名を確認してから再度相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発送を保留し両住所欄と名前確認後に戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sige po. Iuuwi ang label at kukonsulta muli matapos tiyakin ang dalawang address field at recipient name.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipagpaliban ang shipping at bumalik matapos tiyakin ang parehong address at pangalan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、記入欄の案内をお渡しします。差出人の情報は宛先と混ぜないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-BUNKYO-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ibibigay ang gabay sa pagsulat. Huwag ihalo ang sender at recipient information.
